review_mode: independent source-only; no native browser run, credential read, private config read, or product data mutation

prior_findings.finding: Current dev build provenance was absent
prior_findings.evidence: buildIdentity checks local-dev receipt, manifest/package versions and unpacked tree hash before and after the native harness; runNativeSidepanelQa receives extensionDir, expectedRelease and localDevReceiptPath. The runner still hardcodes the older contained receipt path, so it cannot select the refreshed capture receipt without a source change.

prior_findings.finding: Captured image did not prove the owned current viewport
prior_findings.evidence: The runner reads the controlled page viewport, checks persisted image aspect ratio, decodes the mounted blob preview, and samples three independent fixture color bands from its pixels. This is a meaningful oracle for this one page; no browser result exists yet.

prior_findings.finding: Failure before row assignment could skip cleanup and falsely report no row
prior_findings.evidence: After a completed unique one-row GET on a zero-row fixture baseline, the row is claimed before UI assertions. Recovery requires the same page and sole matching card, uses the real Delete UI, then requires a fresh completed zero-row GET before clearing createdRowMayNeedUiCleanup. If a row cannot be identified or definitive cleanup fails, the flag remains true.

prior_findings.finding: T02 could show pass before T06 cleanup failed
prior_findings.evidence: Both pass cases are appended only after the successful deletion GET and empty gallery agreement.

launch_blockers: The current hardcoded RECEIPT is source-dev-build-093-contained-20260927.json. The refreshed source-dev-build-093-capture-20260927.json must be selectable through a narrowly validated override or a direct constant update, and must pass the existing hash/version checks. The older artifact must not be relabeled as the refreshed build.

basis: The real product path invokes take_screenshot with persistence, reads extend.wbx_screenshot for the canonical URL, mounts a decoded blob preview, and uses the UI Delete path. The runner observes a real completed GET and compares its row to the sole mounted card.

The unique fixture URL and completed empty baseline constrain ownership. Recovery never deletes an unrelated row by broad query or direct database call; unresolved cleanup is surfaced when a safe proof is unavailable.

The result report stores fixed stages, flags, counts, build identity and bounded status. Credentials, approved organization name or ID, file ID, page text, raw network bodies and screenshot pixels are not serialized. The product intentionally retains the uploaded image file in Files after index deletion.
The test has not been run against live UI or subjected to a mutation/gut check. This review cannot certify the product behavior or full forcing-function quality.
